component: Qwen4 (Flash-Next) batched fused GDN speculative verify: B lanes x S rows in one launch, each lane its B=1 fused verify arithmetic at its own width (ragged right padding), with per-lane snapshot / compact-tape rollback
status: implemented; Metal bit-exact per lane vs the B=1 fused verify (and so one-token decode), rollback included, on both Flash-Next artifacts; default OFF behind FlashNextPolicy.fused_gdn_batch_verify (MLX_QWEN4_FUSED_GDN_BATCH_VERIFY). Full-model A/B: no speed gain (-0.3..-2.1% median at 2..16 lanes), tokens identical. Not qualified, not selected.

modifications: mlx2 layout, not TensorFold's: the verify block is the padded (B, S) slab the batched self-MTP round builds (right padding, cache.lengths per lane), states are stacked [B, ...] arrays, so lanes are rebound by offset (L1 prefix) instead of one buffer argument per stream; no stream cap below the validated 16 lanes.

The per-lane body is derived from mlx2's own B=1 verify bodies by checked replacement: the template width S stays the slab extent, while the token loop, the restore-point bound SNAPS and the final conv-window position read the lane's count RS = row_steps[lane] (TensorFold's runtime R). A lane of RS rows therefore runs the B=1 kernel specialized at S = RS. Rows past RS are written as zeros.

Rollback: compact mode rebuilds every lane in one dynamic-count reconstruct dispatch (counts per lane, 0 keeps the checkpoint) and records per_row_fn for a merged ArraysCache; the segmented cache slices per-row results of fn(m). Snapshot mode returns the lane's snapshot.

Admission: speculating, 2..16 lanes, width 2..MAX_VERIFY_STEPS, spans describable (no leading pad), one span per lane in 1..S, a mask only when the spans explain it, the B=1 verify's gate/geometry/shape/dtype checks with the lane extent; refusals counted per reason; mode 'off' is the kill switch (B>1 blocks then take the stock chain and the B=1 path's counted 'batch of N rows' refusal).

The stock multi-row chain with the same one-token projections is also per-lane equal (120/120).
